tools.name: search_credit_cards
tools.description: Search current Point Hacks credit card offers (sign-up bonuses and rewards cards). Returns live, published offers with the card name and a link to its guide. Leave the query empty to list top current offers.

query.description: Card or issuer name, e.g. "Qantas" or "ANZ". Optional.

tools.name: search_pointhacks
tools.description: Search Point Hacks articles, guides and news about credit cards, frequent flyer programs and travel rewards. Returns matching pages with their titles and URLs.

query.description: Search terms, e.g. "Qantas points" or "Amex Platinum".
